verdicts.title: The $H \underline{\mathbb{F}}_2$-homology of $C_2$-equivariant Eilenberg-MacLane spaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We extend Ravenel-Wilson Hopf ring techniques to $C_2$-equivariant homotopy theory. Our main application and motivation is a computation of the $RO(C_2)$-graded homology of $C_2$-equivariant Eilenberg-MacLane spaces. The result we obtain for $C_2$-equivariant Eilenberg-MacLane spaces associated to the constant Mackey functor $\underline{\mathbb{F}}_2$ gives a $C_2$-equivariant analogue of the classical computation due to Serre. verdicts.title: Algebraic extensions of an Eilenberg-MacLane spectrum
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The paper gives an answer to the question whether the Galois, separable or etale extension of an Eilenberg-MacLane spectrum in the category of ring spectra is again an Eilenberg-MacLane spectrum. We get a full answer in the Galois case. The question in separable and etale cases is answered only under additional hypothesis.
